title: Grateful Dead Live at Roanoke Civic Center on 1987-07-08
lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby Decoded on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions). FLAC'd using Audiofile Engineering Sample Manager.
source: 2 Nakamichi CM100s/CP4>Sony TCD5M w/Dolby Maxell MX90s cassettes. 5th row behind Board, DFC (Sec LT5 Row E Seat 5)

ai_review.summary: Clean tape captures a solid Roanoke show with standout performances of Cumberland Blues, Crazy Fingers, and Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers agree this July‑8‑1987 Roanoke concert is a hidden gem – a well‑played set that shines especially on the bluesy first‑set cuts and an emotionally charged second set highlighted by Scarlet Fire, Crazy Fingers and Sugar Magnolia. The recording is praised as clear and clean, making it an enjoyable listen despite the show falling in what some consider a weaker year for the Dead.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for musical performance (70% weight) and clean, clear audio (30% weight) across three detailed reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the tape as clean and crisp with no major drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A solid first set of blues‑heavy numbers flows into a sentimental, tight second set where the crowd erupts, especially during Scarlet Fire and the high‑energy jams on Crazy Fingers and Sugar Magnolia.
